id: title:Gilbert09:avoid lazy schema fetch in table statistics activity

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse statistics computation and connection pooling reliability
review.reason: The change explicitly assigns a loaded schema to the job object before downstream use, preventing a redundant database lookup. This is supported by assertions and tests that verify no database queries are issued during this access. This reduces transient database connection errors and unnecessary load on warehouse connections during warehouse statistics computation.
review.uncertainty: While the code demonstrates a clear optimization and regression protection, the actual reduction in transient connection errors and its impact on production stability is not independently verified by this patch alone; the benefit relies on the shared state and connection pool behavior not changing elsewhere.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds explicit assignment of the already-loaded schema to the job object before downstream use, and adds a test asserting no database query is issued when accessing folder_path on that job.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces transient database connection errors in warehouse statistics computation by avoiding a lazy database lookup on a pooled connection that may have been released mid-transaction.

observations.behavior: Adds database query capture and an assertion that no queries are executed when accessing folder_path on a job whose schema was already loaded, and adds a test explicitly checking this behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and documentation of the behavior change: warehouse statistics computation no longer performs an unnecessary database query, reducing transient connection errors.
